# Lane Packet Template

Use only when a disjoint lane adds value. Delegation alone does not select
Heavy. A shared toolchain is serial only while mutable state is shared.

```markdown
Objective:
Authority / permission:
Allowed / read-only / forbidden paths:
Acceptance:
Focused checks:
Dependencies / shared mutable state:
Stop conditions:
Return evidence / ACTIVE_CONTEXT proposal:
```

An authorized isolated lane may commit locally. Push, merge, shared-file
integration, and product acceptance remain controller/owner decisions. A
mechanical wording/status/EOF fix closes with a focused check; semantic
correction receives one targeted re-review.
